name: State Diagram
when_to_pick: Visualize a state machine — a finite set of named states with explicit transitions. Ideal for an automated bot's operational lifecycle (idle → scanning → in-trade → closing → cooldown, plus a halted error state), an order's lifecycle (pending → working → filled/cancelled → reconciled), or a prop-firm challenge progression (phase 1 → phase 2 → funded → breach). Pick this over a flowchart when the subject is 'what mode is it in right now and how does it move between modes', not 'how do I decide'. Use classDef with 8-digit-hex fills to color states by meaning (active/green, risk/red, waiting/blue).

source.description: Raw mermaid source starting with 'stateDiagram-v2'. Use composite states (state "Label" as Id { ... }) to group sub-machines. Color states by meaning with classDef + class. NEVER use rgba(R,G,B,A) inside classDef or style (commas break the parser) — use 8-digit hex (#RRGGBBAA). Do NOT set a text color: property in classDef; the renderer strips it so node text always inherits the theme-correct color in both light and dark.

caption.description: One-sentence takeaway that names the 'aha' — e.g. which transition is the one readers most often get wrong.
